scenarios.causalMutation: Emit two campaign ids in one review package.
Inject a family outside the Goal 043/047/057 family set.

diagnostics.message: Campaign families must resolve to the required three family ids.

scenarios.causalMutation: Claim arbitrary Lua execution during campaign proof.
Mutate a staged media file after Goal 056/057 hash validation.

diagnostics.message: Staged media hashes must match prior accepted manifests.

scenarios.causalMutation: Remove the staged campaign/family command plan.

diagnostics.message: Unity player proof requires the staged campaign command plan.

scenarios.causalMutation: Remove Goal 057 player proof and family command plan.

diagnostics.message: Goal 057 accepted source evidence is required.
Campaign review package requires every staged media file from Goal 057.

scenarios.causalMutation: Publish a package without source/review trace refs.

diagnostics.message: Review package must preserve source and media provenance.

scenarios.causalMutation: Omit a campaign_loaded or campaign_family_completed marker from player logs.

diagnostics.message: Unity player logs must contain every required campaign marker.

scenarios.causalMutation: Shuffle source, family, stage or command records.

diagnostics.message: Campaign records must be deterministically ordered.

scenarios.causalMutation: Claim provider, network, LLM or RAG execution.

diagnostics.message: Provider, network, LLM and RAG calls are forbidden.
Goal 058 may only consume accepted fixture media evidence.

scenarios.causalMutation: Claim Runtime, UI or public GamePackage schema mutation.
Mark Goal 058 passed from its own production result.

diagnostics.message: Goal 058 must remain required until user acceptance.

scenarios.causalMutation: Change a consumed source artifact after its hash was recorded.

diagnostics.message: Source artifact bytes must match recorded hashes.

scenarios.causalMutation: Replace or broaden Unity Alpha architecture.

diagnostics.message: Only deterministic campaign marker support is allowed.

scenarios.causalMutation: Use absolute paths or traversal inside staging/review package.

diagnostics.message: Campaign paths must be safe relative paths.
